name: Pizzeria West
kurzbeschreibung: **Pizzeria West** in **Innsbruck** – where authentic Italian flavors meet the charm of the **Tirol** Alps. Enjoy freshly baked pizzas with regional ingredients, from crispy **Kaiserschmarrn** to hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**, all served in a cozy, rustic setting. Whether you crave a classic **Margherita** or a bold **Diavola**, our wood-fired pizzas are baked to perfection. Pair your meal with a glass of fine local wine or a frothy **Tiroler Bier** for the ultimate alpine dining experience. Just a short stroll from the **Goldenes Dachl**, **Pizzeria West** is the perfect spot for pizza lovers and foodies alike.
